::: {#cor-prior-support}
#### The posterior cannot put probability where the prior puts none

If $\p(\param) = 0$ for every $\param$ in a set $A \subset \Paramspace$,
then $\p(\param \mid \vy) = 0$ for every $\param \in A$,
whatever the data $\vy$.
:::

::: proof
For $\param \in A$,
the numerator of @eq-bayes-posterior is
$\p(\vy \mid \param) \cdot 0 = 0$.
:::
